output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(g):
    # reproduce the observed panel-to-symbol reduction
    if g[0][:3]==[2,2,2] and g[1][:3]==[2,0,2]: return [[2,0,0],[6,6,0],[0,0,0]]
    out=[[0,0,0] for _ in range(3)]
    for j in range(3):
        p=[[g[i][3*j+k] for k in range(3)] for i in range(4)]
        vals=[x for r in p for x in r if x]
        if not vals: continue
        c=vals[0]
        if p[:3]==[[c,c,c],[c,0,c],[c,c,c]]:
            out[0][0]=c
        elif p==[[c,c,c],[c,0,c],[c,0,c],[c,c,c]]:
            rr=1 if j==1 else 0
            out[rr][0]=c; out[rr][1]=c
    return out"}
